about_the_game:
"O Último dos Moicanos" is a Tower Defense game with a touch of action and strategy, set in a post-apocalyptic future where the only thing left on Earth is a simple — yet resilient — farm owned by a lone archer.

After a devastating invasion by beings from other planets, what remained of human civilization was reduced to dust. Except for one thing: the farm of the last archer farmer. Determined to protect his land until the end, he becomes humanity’s final hope.
But the aliens know this. They know that this farm is the last barrier standing in the way of total planetary domination. And they’ll do everything they can to destroy it.

You take on the role of this heroic farmer, facing waves of alien enemies across 10 challenging levels. With each stage, your chance of victory drops, making the journey even more tense and strategic:

Level 1: 90% chance of victory
Level 2: 80%
...
Level 10: Only a 5% chance of success!

And there’s more: if you lose at any stage, you go back to the beginning. With each attempt, the pressure builds and your skill is pushed to the limit.

Can you defend the last living land on the planet?
Or will you let them take it all?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 ou superior (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (ou equivalente AMD)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 ou equivalente
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatível com DirectX
  • Additional Notes: Funciona mesmo em PCs fracos
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) ou superior
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 ou superior
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 ou superior
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatível com DirectX
  • Additional Notes: Ideal para aproveitar o melhor desempenho do jogo

short_description: A strategy and defense game where you control an archer farmer, facing waves of alien enemies across 10 challenging levels. Build, defend, and fight to protect the last farm on Earth. Every defeat sends you back to the beginning.
